arguments.message:
Hi there,

No – Meridian never asks customers to wire money to a new bank account via email, especially not as an urgent or overdue payment request. If you receive such an email, it’s not from us. Please do not reply, click any links, or make a payment. Instead, log into your account and check the billing status in Settings → Billing to see if any payment is actually due.

If you have any further concerns, let us know.

Best,
Meridian Support
